_comment: Maps a compilation target to the predefined GNAT runtime and gnatemu board gnattest uses to build and run the TGen value-generation harness on target. Only the type layout (target ABI) matters for value generation, so a gnatemu-supported runtime is used regardless of the runtime the user's project declares. The runtime must be an embedded-class runtime rich enough to host the generation side (System.Random_Numbers, containers, big numerics). 'board' is optional. Users can extend/override this mapping with --tgen-target-config=<file>.
